claim: All baseline structural outputs (E1, E2, E3) regenerate identically in a clean Python 3.12.13 environment on Windows 11; figures are pixel-identical; numerical differences are 1-ULP-level (<= 9e-15) or wall-clock fields.
reproduce: python scripts/run_e1_audit.py; python scripts/run_e2_sensitivity.py; python scripts/run_e3_readability.py; python technical/verification/compare_trees.py <baseline> <regen> out.json
caveat: PNG bytes and text line endings differ by platform; compared by pixel and newline-normalised text

claim: ripser 0.6.15, persim 0.4.1, kmapper 2.1.0 (and the other pinned packages) were the latest PyPI releases on 2026-10-28 and install as wheels on Python 3.12 / Windows.
The kmapper 2.1.0 HTML export loads D3 6.1.1, FileSaver 2.0.2 and a Google font from CDNs; in a cold-cache offline browser it throws 'd3 is not defined' and draws 0 nodes and 0 edges.
ripser 0.6.15 does not export a plotting function; plot_dgms was already absent in 0.3.2; persim provides plot_diagrams and no barcode plot.
The raw GSOD files for station 72505394728 (2019-2024) re-downloaded from NOAA NCEI on 2026-10-28 are byte-identical to the archived copies and to the recorded SHA-256 hashes.
caveat: GSOD terms: free for research and education, no warranty

claim: The D1/D3/D4 controls show that the reliability of the Mapper cycle cue depends on the clustering rule and scale: forced KMeans k=2 vs single-linkage at 3x and 1.5x the median 5-NN distance.
caveat: two scales tried; the larger chosen with the baseline's failure in view; 2-D synthetic shapes only

claim: The dominant H1 class of the weather temperature embedding is attributable to the annual harmonic structure of the series (matched nulls: anomaly series and shuffled series show no dominant class).
caveat: one station, six years; not a climate claim; not evidence of a closed physical trajectory

claim: The static 3-D state-space cloud contrast (r1 = 1.19) is guaranteed by construction (persistence ignores day order; different dimension, variables and density) and is not a null control.
caveat: nearest-neighbour spacing figures are audit measurements

claim: The offline explorer passes 222 independent cold-cache, network-disabled browser checks (every dataset x cell, exports, six viewport sizes).
E3 is a structured single-observer inspection with AI viewing assistance; it is not a participant study and supports statements about artifacts only.

Pre-specification cannot be verified from artifacts: contemporaneous version-control history was not maintained and no independent time stamps exist (the repository history is retrospective and is not evidence of the original chronology); the seasonality check was post hoc; the sweep was designed knowing the annual period.

Persistence-diagram distances against a full-data reference are descriptive resampling-stability quantities, not independent validation; overlapping subsamples understate variability by about 1.4-1.8x for the annulus and figure-eight.

gap_ratio returns None for undefined cases (too few classes, non-positive denominator), inf for an infinite numerator over a finite denominator, and NaN for inf/inf or NaN input (latent, pinned by tests, not triggered by project data); r_k is invariant to constant rescaling.
Future work: clusterer-scale dimension in the explorer; GUDHI cross-check; second station; window-aware bootstrap; participant study only with proper design and approval.
